description: It's an absolute shock and embarrassment that this is the first proper project weekend of the year. Two nights, and two full proj's. One night at the camp site, next night getting messed up in Torridon Youth Hostel (for the first time, by the way), absolutely routine business. The only way it should be. I mean who buys houses when they've got Munros and drinking to do?! Idiot! It was strange heading up north on a Saturday afternoon, felt wrong. But Hostelling Scotland has been the pain of the year, so there wasn't much we could do about it. The campsite was fine, less midge than I had expected from the dark, wet, humid conditions. Couple Blancs always help with that too. Can't complain about much after that, two very routine projects. I felt at home for the first time this year. Torridon Youth Hostel; also now one of the big boys. Great drinking potential, provided people stop reading and drink!!
